entry.title: The experiences Davies wants to leave room for
entry.summary: Davies favors firsthand play, conversation, and shared activity over screens for toddlers. She presents this as part of her Montessori approach and describes her own family’s choices.
entry.cue: You may be considering what fills waiting time or sits in the background at home.
detail: Her practical examples include books or a shared activity when out, a walk to see what is happening nearby, and noticing adults’ own screen use.
Her account also includes occasional selected programs when her children were young. It is not a minute-by-minute plan, and her family’s later computer skills are an anecdote, not a promised result.
For upset feelings, she returns to the support and connection described in her limits chapter.
